issues.detail: The Hebrew text does not contain the name 'Lê-mu-ên' (Lemuel) in this verse; it begins with 'אַל לַמְלָכִים' ('Do not [give] to kings'). The Vietnamese adds 'Hỡi Lê-mu-ên' ('O Lemuel'), which is not present in the Hebrew and changes the addressee.
The Hebrew has 'וּלְרוֹזְנִים אוֹ שֵׁכָר' ('and to rulers, or strong drink'), meaning rulers should not drink strong drink. The Vietnamese adds 'nói:
